platformContract.gameRules: Per-slot acceptance, retransmit/epoch deduplication, music event timeline and pause state belong to Contra.
platformContract.musicPulseOverride: Effect slot4 overrides physical pulse1 while the underlying music slot0 advances. Background pulse1 must not be paused for an effect.
platformContract.noiseOverride: Music noise request0x02 and game effects share slot5; rejected noise requests are discarded, not queued.
platformContract.dpcm: 0x7F..81 directly start DPCM and bypass normal slot priority; DPCM is a separate physical channel.
platformContract.sameTickDuplicates: Keep at most the last accepted request per slot within a tick; equal IDs in later ticks are genuine retriggers.
platformContract.audioPhase: Game F9BC requests are serviced at the following original audio update; music-internal percussion is generated in the current audio update.

limitations: No upload has been performed. The local controller/adapter is verified separately.
Original whole clips cannot be blindly overlaid; partial slot replacement needs stems/timeline rules.
Raw continuous captures are not loop-ready; verified loop derivatives are catalogued separately. Multi-track sync and complete gameplay mixing remain unaccepted.
Separate channel rendering does not recreate the original nonlinear pulse/TND mix or all oscillator-history effects.
Source media are local research candidates. Distribution rights are not established by ROM/content identity.
